response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), shares AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.archstat AS status, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: A missing archstat means a NULL value. GROUP BY places all NULLs in one group, and that group's status is returned as NULL. Blank or whitespace-only strings are not treated as missing.

The average share is the unweighted mean of the per-status shares, and the sum in the denominator is the sum of the per-status distinct-project counts. A project with QC records in several statuses is counted in each of them, as the request describes.

alternatives.interpretation: Blank or whitespace-only archstat values also count as missing and form the same group as NULL.
alternatives.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(archstat), '') AS archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY 1), shares AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, 1.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.archstat AS status, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
